title: Primary policy for Uformer reconstruction diagnostics: two-metric reconstruction screen
status: Prospective from UCX-20261014-v1. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-14 AFTER seeing the UHO-20261014-v1 result (held-out RSE 5.13-6.71, cosine 0.0003-0.069). Applying it to an earlier result is retrospective, is labelled as such and never replaces that result's recorded verdict. UPP-20261013-v1 remains the pinned policy of UCOV-20261013-v1 and UHO-20261014-v1.

basis.state: the final registered state of the method, never a best intermediate point
basis.space: original (unnormalized) space of the tested input
basis.predictions: the registered predictions as decoded from the transmitted payload

quantities.sums: SSE = sum((x_hat - x)^2), T = sum(x^2), P = sum(x_hat^2), D = sum(x_hat * x), N = number of elements; float64 reductions of the registered final eval-mode prediction
quantities.rse: SSE / T, without a square root; undefined if T <= 0
quantities.cosine: D / sqrt(P * T); undefined if P <= 0 or T <= 0
quantities.pooled: a pooled unit (for example a cohort of tiles) sums the per-tile float64 SSE, T, P, D and N with math.fsum and applies the same definitions to the pooled sums (a ratio of sums, not a mean of ratios)

comparisons: inclusive, in float64, against the literal thresholds above, with no epsilon or tolerance
degenerate_input: a registered input with a non-finite element, or whose target energy T is not a finite positive number (RSE undefined)

report_only.mse_over_best_constant_baseline: MSE / min(zero-prediction MSE, scalar-mean MSE), reported when defined; never affects the outcome, and its absence or undefinedness never affects the outcome either
report_only.historical_baseline_condition: MSE <= 0.8 x best constant baseline, the third condition of UPP-20261013-v1; reported only, it cannot veto a PASS

removed_relative_to_UPP-20261013-v1: the baseline condition MSE <= 0.8 x best constant baseline as a pass requirement (now report-only)
the NONINFORMATIVE outcome (it existed only for the baseline condition)
the constant-input degeneracy condition (RSE and cosine stay defined for a constant non-zero input)
the normalized max |x_n| >= 1 degeneracy condition (values outside the training-calibrated Tanh range are evaluated as distribution-shift observations)

UPP-20261013-v1.role: historical policy, pinned by the protocols that used it; not applied by this classifier and cannot veto a PASS

EP-20261012-v1.role: historical policy; not applied by this classifier and cannot veto a PASS

historical_strict.role: historical near-identity criterion; not applied by this classifier and cannot veto a PASS

interpretation: A PASS is a permissive reconstruction-screen result. It is not identity reconstruction, compression, full LoRA-update fidelity, task or FAF utility, or superiority over other codecs.
